AC-0106 — Greedy meshing of opaque block faces

Status: DONE (2026-08-25, Run-2 builder). Scope: godot/world/chunk.gd only. Goal: merge co-planar adjacent opaque block faces into larger quads to cut vertex count ~60–80% with zero visual change (genhash 25/25 byte-identical = hard gate).

1. What was built

  • Group key = (block id, face index, face-normal index, exact face-light shade) + fixed plane/y-row. Equal-shade key ⇒ merged-quad vertex color is uniform ⇒ lighting rasterizes identically to per-block quads (no light-step interpolation).
  • Merge algorithm: per-face-index 3D grid of exposed faces → greedy rectangles: grow a maximal horizontal run, then extend downward (v-axis) up to H=4 while the full width key-matches on every row (bounded 2D greedy). Strip-only pass measured 57.3% < 60% target, so the plan-§7 escalation to 2D was triggered.
  • Runtime-extended atlas: blocks_atlas.png is a grayscale placeholder (colors come from vertex tints), so a plain texture repeat can't tile per-texel. _merge_atlas() builds at first mesh build (cached statically, invalidated on atlas identity change) a taller canvas: original 1024×1024 blitted + 25 merge-strips (16 tile-repeats × 4 tile-rows each, 512×128 px) appended below the original tiles. Merged-quad UV = strip origin + 0.5 + 31·block-coord (slope 31 = original per-block mapping). No asset files touched.
  • Kill-switch: AWECRAFT_MERGE=0 forces the original per-block emitter (documented deviation, see §5).

5. Deviations & notes

  1. Runtime-extended atlas (documented in plan §5 risk): the merge path cannot tile the atlas per-texel with linear UV, so the merged surface uses a taller runtime-built canvas (original pixels byte-identical at original coords; strips appended below). Fallback + all other surfaces use the original atlas texture. Pack-swap safe (static cache keyed on atlas identity). If a future atlas pack makes the canvas >4096px tall, _merge_atlas bails to the original emitter (no merge) — safe degradation, documented.
  2. ≤1px sampling-phase band: merged-quad UVs advance 31px per block against 32px-pitch blitted tiles, so texels at block boundaries sample up to 1px earlier in the tile than the per-block path — sub-texel at game scale, invisible in the 1:1 crops; visible only as the fine speckle in the diff mask.
  3. Equal-shade group key: merging requires the exact same face-light shade, so light-step boundaries always terminate a merge (no interpolation across a shade change). Cost: slightly fewer merges than shade-blind greedy; lighting remains exact.
  4. Bounded H=4: vertical (v-axis) growth is capped at 4 rows, matching the 4-tile-row atlas strips; taller matching walls split into ≤4-tall quads. Unbounded H would need unbounded strip height; 4 already delivers the 67.2% target.
  5. AWECRAFT_MERGE=0 kill-switch kept in build_mesh (env-gated, off by default) for A/B debugging and rollback.
  6. Battery baseline correction: the mid-run checkpoint value horizontal_moved 2.46 was captured while the merge path had missing faces (collision holes) — a buggy-state artifact. Every pre-AC-0106 battery log (ac0075, ac0079fix, ac0079r3, ac0085, punch_final) shows 2.82 / after_fwd [8.5, 5.68]; final runs match 2.82 exactly with merge ON and OFF. All other battery values match known-stable exactly.
  7. Vert metric: MINFO opaque = surf0 only; fluid surfaces (1/2) and flora reported separately and byte-identical pre/post (68,472 unchanged).
  8. Bugs found & fixed during the session (all in the merged path, none in shared code): (A) vertical-face corner-y mirror (winding), (B) fi2/fi3 v0/plane swap, (C) bit-packed grid keys colliding for y≥16 (→ arithmetic 3D keys), (D) atlas canvas bail at 25 strips × 4 rows (→ Image.create_empty canvas growth). Each fix re-verified against the per-bucket area invariant.
